subject: Post-call recap & pilot playbook — Cartograph Systems
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@cartographsys.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus.dangelo@cartographsys.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + initial asks after today's discovery

Lauren — thanks for the thoughtful demo and discussion today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can align on a short pilot: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Current search summarization pipeline is brittle: hallucinations and inconsistent relevance when query context grows beyond a few hundred tokens.
- Primary goal: improve answer relevance and factuality when summarizing multi-document client reports.
- Secondary goal: reduce inference spend per session by at least 30% vs our baseline.

Proposed pilot scope & asks (what we'd like to validate in 6 weeks)
1) End-to-end test on 10k historical reports (offloaded) to measure factuality + ROUGE/ROUGE-L, and a human QA pass on a 200-report sample.
2) Latency SLO: 95th percentile <= 400ms for the shortest query patterns (single doc + query).
3) Cost: target token/unit cost that beats our current vendor by >=30%.
4) Security: need SOC2 evidence and suggested network setup for staging.

Immediate asks from Cartograph: 
- Can you share a simple POC runbook and an access checklist we can review with infra?
- Example prompt set we can use for our first QA batch (200 reports).
- A draft mutual action plan with owners and milestones.

Attachments: a one-page architecture snapshot (cartograph-contract-questions.pdf) — contains IPS, current throughput numbers, and redlines we anticipate.

Thanks — happy to coordinate a kickoff next week if that works.

— Alyssa
Director of Data Products
Cartograph Systems
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@cartographsys.com>
Cc: marcus.dangelo@cartographsys.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + initial asks after today's discovery

Alyssa — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment, super helpful. High-level response and a proposed pilot playbook below. My aim here is to make next steps concrete so your infra and product teams can gate what we need.

Quick takeaways (agreeing back)
- Primary validation = relevance/factuality on multi-doc summaries (200 human-reviewed samples within pilot).
- Secondary validation = 30%+ cost reduction target and latency SLO for common query patterns.

Proposed 6-week pilot playbook (outline)
Week 0 (kickoff):
- Confirm dataset transfer method (S3 presigned URL or staging VPC).
- Security review: share SOC2 + SOC2-plus paper; propose temporary read-only staging bucket.
- Owners: Lauren (sales/coord), Karthik (SE lead), Monica (CS success).
Week 1–2 (integration & baseline):
- Access: staging cluster + API keys for read-only test runs.
- Run baseline on a 1k sample to capture current metrics (latency, token usage, ROUGE).
Week 3–4 (tuning & evals):
- Run model variants (optimizations + quantized options), run prompt set A/B.
- Produce 200 human QA reviews and automated ROUGE/EM metrics.
Week 5–6 (finalize & handoff):
- Consolidate findings, cost comparison, and rollout recommendations.

Success criteria (explicit)
- Human QA: >=15% lift in relevance/factuality score (per agreed rubric) on the 200-sample set.
- Latency: p95 <= 400ms for single-doc queries in staging runs.
- Cost: expected per-session token cost <= 70% of current vendor.

Access checklist (what we need from Cartograph)
- Staging S3 or read-only VPC access (preferred)
- Sample prompt + label format (CSV/JSON) — we can start with an example.
- Name and contact for infra reviewer for SOC2/KMS questions.

Deliverables from Redwood
- POC runbook (step-by-step), suggested prompt set + sample labeled pairs (attached cartograph-sample-prompts.csv), and a template mutual action plan (we'll populate owners/dates).

I attached the sample prompts and a one-page runbook stub. Next step: Can we lock a 45-min kickoff on Monday 4/30 or Tuesday 5/1 (PST)? I'll send calendar options after your confirmation.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0117
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@cartographsys.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + initial asks after today's discovery

Thanks, Lauren. A few technical notes to set expectations and a short checklist for infra so the kickoff is productive: 

Technical clarifications
- Data: For the 10k historical reports we'll want either S3 (preferred) with object prefixes for the pilot subset, or a secure FTP. Presigned S3 URLs for the 200-sample human QA are fine but we recommend a temporary staging bucket for repeatability.
- Tokenization: please confirm whether the report text will be pre-chunked and whether there are existing extractive summaries you want included in prompts. If not, we'll apply our standard chunker (we can share parameters).
- Model variants: we'll run 3 variants — base open model, Redwood-optimized quantized variant, and a fallback smaller variant for cost comparison. Expect ~2–3x query cost delta across extremes before tuning.

Infra checklist for Cartograph (quick)
- Provide read-only IAM role or presigned bucket + sample S3 path for the 1k baseline.
- Network: if you prefer VPC peering, share CIDR and point of contact; otherwise we'll use HTTPS endpoints.
- Auth: SAML/SSO for long-lived users is optional during pilot; API keys for testing will work.

I'll prepare the runbook commands and a minimal Docker-based runner we can share in the kickoff. Monica — can you own the human QA coordination? Lauren — if we lock the kickoff, I’ll drop a short tech pre-read into the Drive link.

— Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus D'Angelo <marcus.dangelo@cartographsys.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@cartographsys.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + initial asks after today's discovery

Lauren / Karthik — appreciate the structured playbook. Confirming a kickoff on Tuesday 2027-05-04 10:00am PST works for our team (we'll send a calendar invite). A couple of immediate notes from infra/security: 

- We'll provision a read-only staging bucket and share a presigned path for the 1k baseline by EOD Friday 4/30. Point of contact: me (marcus.dangelo@cartographsys.com).
- For SOC2 evidence, please send the zip/email with the control matrix and auditor contact — we need to attach that to our internal risk ticket.
- We'll upload the 200-sample human QA CSV using the template you attached. Expect a raw dataset + labels column.

One ask: Can Redwood provide a short example of a successful prompt + expected model reply (no PII) that we can show our product team during the kickoff? If you can include that in the Drive pre-read, that would be ideal.

Thanks — we'll accept the sample prompts and the runbook attached and circulate internally. Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Marcus
VP, Platform Engineering
Cartograph Systems
